prompt: Do not modify files. A web test fails about 1 in 10 runs with a timeout. What may and may not be done about it in this project?
rubric: Says retries/reruns, sleeps, longer arbitrary waits and loosened assertions are not allowed; root-cause the flakiness (synchronization, data collision, order dependence, environment, locator, product race) using flaky-test-management; if a fix takes time, quarantine with @pytest.mark.quarantine(reason=ticket, until=date), excluded from gating runs and verified before removal.

prompt: Do not modify files. Where do locators, engine library imports and assertions belong in this framework, and what enforces it?
rubric: Locators in page/screen/service objects (interaction layer), never in tests; engine libraries imported only by their driver layer; assertions in tests or verification helpers, not in page objects; enforced by docs/design/layers.toml with scripts/architecture_check.py and by scripts/hygiene_check.py (H002) plus review checklists.

prompt: Do not modify files. We want to start building desktop automation support. What must happen before any framework code is written?
rubric: Framework capability spec (taf-spec); ADR for desktop automation technology (D-02) with a spike on the real application; HLD update with layers.toml, ports and contract tests, execution constraints for interactive Windows sessions; LLD for the driver and screen objects; design-reviewer approval; then contract-first tests.

prompt: Do not modify files. What rules apply to handling SOAP responses and credentials in API tests here?
rubric: Parse XML only with defusedxml or a hardened parser (no DTD/external entities); WS-Security credentials from the secret store, never in envelopes or data files (hook-enforced); redact security headers in evidence; validate against XSD/WSDL; assert SOAP faults explicitly; TLS verification on.
